name: Semiconductors
targetResearchers: Solid-state physicists, electrical engineers, and materials scientists working on lithography, novel transistor architectures, photonics, and advanced packaging
useCases: Joint development with consortia like imec
description: The semiconductor industry depends on a deep bench of academic device physicists and materials scientists to push past the limits of conventional scaling. Leading firms fund university cleanrooms, co-author with consortium labs, and compete aggressively for EE and solid-state-physics PhDs who can work on lithography, photonics, and advanced packaging. The talent pipeline from academic fabs is treated as a strategic asset.
